_comment: Fictional search thresholds for tools/cn_jd_check.py. Not a real person: no name, phone, email, or ID. Copy this file to config/cn_filters.json (gitignored) and edit that copy. The checker reads cn_filters.json when it exists; these example numbers are hints only. Do not put real personal data in this file. campus.mode: auto detects JD 校招/应届/实习/届; campus/intern/experienced override the mode, never student identity. graduation_year is a four-digit graduation cohort, not birth year. salary.min_daily is yuan/day, never monthly K. labor.candidate_is_student is the sole confirmed student-status setting; null means unknown.
